relationships.subject: Huwentoxin-IV
relationships.evidence_quote: It is an inhibitory cysteine knot (ICK) peptide that blocks Nav1.7 and other TTX-sensitive voltage-gated sodium channels with an IC50 of ~30 nM [44]

relationships.subject: GpTX-1
relationships.evidence_quote: mediates its Nav1.7 block through an interaction with VSD2 with an IC50 of 10 nM [61,62]

relationships.subject: Pn3a
relationships.evidence_quote: Pn3a was a potent inhibitor of NaV1.7 (IC50 0.8 nM)

relationships.subject: ProTX-II
relationships.evidence_quote: ProTX-II was subsequently shown to be one of the most potent and selective Nav1.7 blockers known, with an IC50 of 0.3 nM for Nav1.7

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: The sodium channel subtype Nav1.7 is critical for the transmission of pain-related signaling

key_findings: Review of engineered spider-venom ICK peptides (HwTX-IV, GpTX-1, CcoTX-1, Pn3a, ProTX-II) as Nav1.7-selective antagonists.
Selectivity over Nav1.2/Nav1.6 and in vivo systemic efficacy remain the main challenges; Pn3a efficacy varies by pain model.
